pairs: Locutusque est Dominus ad Moysen,
And the Lord spoke to Moses,
dicens:
saying:
Loquere filiis Israël:
Say to the sons of Israel:
Anima, quæ peccaverit per ignorantiam,
The soul which will have sinned through ignorance,
et de universis mandatis Domini, quæ præcepit ut non fierent,
and concerning any of the commandments of the Lord that he instructed not to be done,
quippiam fecerit:
if anything at all has been done:
si sacerdos,
if the priest,
qui unctus est,
who is anointed,
peccaverit,
will have sinned,
delinquere faciens populum,
causing the people to commit a transgression,
offeret pro peccato suo vitulum immaculatum Domino:
he shall offer to the Lord for his sin an immaculate calf.
et adducet illum ad ostium tabernaculi testimonii coram Domino,
And he shall lead it to the door of the tabernacle of the testimony in the sight of the Lord.
ponetque manum super caput ejus,
And he shall place his hand upon its head,
et immolabit eum Domino.
and he shall immolate it to the Lord.
Hauriet quoque de sanguine vituli,
Likewise, he shall take from the blood of the calf,
inferens illum in tabernaculum testimonii.
carrying it into the tabernacle of the testimony,
Cumque intinxerit digitum in sanguine,
and having dipped his finger into the blood,
asperget eo septies coram Domino contra velum sanctuarii.
he shall sprinkle it seven times in the sight of the Lord, opposite the veil of the Sanctuary.
Ponetque de eodem sanguine super cornua altaris thymiamatis gratissimi Domino,
And he shall place some of the same blood over the horns of the altar of most pleasing incense to the Lord,
quod est in tabernaculo testimonii:
which is in the tabernacle of the testimony.
omnem autem reliquum sanguinem fundet in basim altaris holocausti in introitu tabernaculi.
Then he shall pour out the remainder of the blood at the base of the altar of holocaust at the entrance of the tabernacle.
Et adipem vituli auferet pro peccato,
And, on behalf of the sin, he shall take the fat of the calf,
tam eum qui vitalia operit quam omnia quæ intrinsecus sunt:
both that which covers the vital organs and all that is interior,
duos renunculos
the two little kidneys,
et reticulum quod est super eos juxta ilia,
and the mesh that is on them near the sides,
et adipem jecoris cum renunculis,
and the fat of the liver with the little kidneys,
sicut aufertur de vitulo hostiæ pacificorum:
just as it is taken from the calf of the sacrifice of peace offerings.
et adolebit ea super altare holocausti.
And he shall burn them upon the altar of holocaust.
Pellem vero et omnes carnes,
Yet truly, the skin and all the flesh,
cum capite et pedibus et intestinis et fimo,
with the head and the feet, and the intestines and the dung,
et reliquo corpore,
and the remainder of the body,
efferet extra castra in locum mundum,
he shall carry away, beyond the camp,
ubi cineres effundi solent:
to the clean place where the ashes are usually poured out.
incendetque ea super lignorum struem,
And he shall burn them upon a stack of wood. There,
quæ in loco effusorum cinerum cremabuntur.
in the place where the ashes have been poured out, they will be burned.
Quod si omnis turba Israël ignoraverit,
But if all the crowd of Israel will have been ignorant,
et per imperitiam fecerit quod contra mandatum Domini est,
and through inexperience will have done what is contrary to the commandment of the Lord,
et postea intellexerit peccatum suum,
and afterwards shall understand their sin:
offeret pro peccato suo vitulum,
they shall offer a calf on behalf of their sin,
adducetque eum ad ostium tabernaculi.
and they shall lead it to the door of the tabernacle.
Et ponent seniores populi manus super caput ejus coram Domino.
And the elders of the people shall place their hands upon its head in the sight of the Lord.
Immolatoque vitulo in conspectu Domini,
And when the calf has been immolated in the sight of the Lord,
inferet sacerdos, qui unctus est, de sanguine ejus in tabernaculum testimonii,
the priest who is anointed shall carry some of its blood into the tabernacle of the testimony.
tincto digito aspergens septies contra velum.
and he shall dip his finger in it, sprinkling it seven times opposite the veil.
Ponetque de eodem sanguine in cornibus altaris,
And he shall place some of the same blood on the horns of the altar,
quod est coram Domino in tabernaculo testimonii:
which is in the presence of the Lord in the tabernacle of the testimony.
reliquum autem sanguinem fundet juxta basim altaris holocaustorum,
But the remainder of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of holocaust,
quod est in ostio tabernaculi testimonii.
which is at the door of the tabernacle of the testimony.
Omnemque ejus adipem tollet,
And he shall take all its fat
et adolebit super altare:
and burn it upon the altar,
sic faciens et de hoc vitulo quomodo fecit et prius:
doing so with this calf in the same manner as he did before.
et rogante pro eis sacerdote,
And while the priest is praying for them,
propitius erit eis Dominus.
the Lord will forgive them.
Ipsum autem vitulum efferet extra castra,
But the calf itself he shall carry away, beyond the camp,
atque comburet sicut et priorem vitulum:
and he shall also burn it, just as with the previous calf,
quia est pro peccato multitudinis.
because it is for the sin of the multitude.
Si peccaverit princeps,
If a leader will have sinned,
et fecerit unum e pluribus per ignorantiam, quod Domini lege prohibetur:
and through ignorance will have done one of the many things which the law of the Lord prohibits,
et postea intellexerit peccatum suum,
and afterwards he shall understand his sin:
offeret hostiam Domino,
he shall offer an immaculate he-goat from among the goats,
hircum de capris immaculatum.
as a sacrifice to the Lord.
Ponetque manum suam super caput ejus:
And he shall place his hand upon its head.
cumque immolaverit eum loco ubi solet mactari holocaustum coram Domino,
And when he will have immolated it, in the place where the holocaust is usually slain, in the sight of the Lord,
quia pro peccato est,
because it is for sin,
tinget sacerdos digitum in sanguine hostiæ pro peccato,
the priest shall dip his finger in the blood of the victim for sin,
tangens cornua altaris holocausti,
touching the horns of the altar of holocaust,
et reliquum fundens ad basim ejus.
and pouring out the remainder at its base.
Adipem vero adolebit supra,
Yet truly,
sicut in victimis pacificorum fieri solet:
the fat he shall burn upon it,
rogabitque pro eo sacerdos,
just as is usually done with the victims of peace offerings.
et pro peccato ejus,
And the priest shall pray for him and for his sin,
et dimittetur ei.
and he shall be released from it.
Quod si peccaverit anima per ignorantiam, de populo terræ,
But if a soul from the people of the land will have sinned through ignorance,
ut faciat quidquam de his, quæ Domini lege prohibentur,
so as to have done any of those things that the law of the Lord prohibits,
atque delinquat,
and so commit a transgression,
et cognoverit peccatum suum,
and he shall realize his sin:
offeret capram immaculatam.
he shall offer an immaculate she-goat.
Ponetque manum super caput hostiæ quæ pro peccato est,
And he shall place his hand upon the head of the victim which is for sin.
et immolabit eam in loco holocausti.
And he shall immolate it in the place of the holocaust.
Tolletque sacerdos de sanguine in digito suo:
And the priest shall take some of the blood with his finger,
et tangens cornua altaris holocausti,
and touching the horns of the altar of holocaust,
reliquum fundet ad basim ejus.
he shall pour out the remainder at its base.
Omnem autem adipem auferens,
But taking away all the fat,
sicut auferri solet de victimis pacificorum,
just as it is usually taken away from the victims of peace offerings,
adolebit super altare in odorem suavitatis Domino:
he shall burn it upon the altar as a sweet odor to the Lord.
rogabitque pro eo,
And he shall pray for him,
et dimittetur ei.
and he shall be released from it.
Sin autem de pecoribus obtulerit victimam pro peccato,
But if instead he will offer from the flock a victim for his sin,
ovem scilicet immaculatam:
specifically, an immaculate female sheep:
ponet manum super caput ejus,
he shall place his hand upon its head,
et immolabit eam in loco ubi solent cædi holocaustorum hostiæ.
and he shall immolate it in the place where the victims of holocausts are usually slain.
Sumetque sacerdos de sanguine ejus digito suo,
And the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger,
et tangens cornua altaris holocausti,
and touching the horns of the altar of holocaust,
reliquum fundet ad basim ejus.
he shall pour out the remainder at its base.
Omnem quoque adipem auferens,
Likewise, all of the fat shall be taken away,
sicut auferri solet adeps arietis,
just as the fat of the ram,
qui immolatur pro pacificis,
which is immolated for peace offerings,
cremabit super altare in incensum Domini: rogabitque pro eo,
is usually taken away. And he shall burn it upon the altar as an incense of the Lord.
et pro peccato ejus,
And he shall pray for him and for his sin,
et dimittetur ei.
and he shall be released from it.
